window_and_velocity: reuse G2 best fixed temporal; no additional sweep
candidate_source: current A full-gallery Top-50, no GT
train_statistics: median A top1-top2 gap and median valid T top1-top2 gap on train only
continuity: mean of up to last two T-top1 reference-index steps agreeing with median declared velocity within 1 reference index; first valid T has 1; reset each split
candidate_agreement: 1 if full-gallery T top1 belongs to current A Top-50, else 0.25
extra_fixed_controls: Top-50 restricted best G2 fixed blend
stop_rule: If adaptive does not exceed best mature fixed temporal/control, do not add mechanisms; use empirical interpretation
SMR_policy: Attempt fixed official-source feature/MLP comparator with adaptations disclosed; failure retained, never invent result
